changeSet.author: logos
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION logos_stats_is_internal_benchmark(le log_entry) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE RETURN le.benchmark_job_id IS NOT NULL OR ( le.environment IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'model-provider-benchmark' AND le.api_key_id IS NULL AND le.team_id IS NULL AND le.user_id IS NULL AND le.privacy_level IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'FULL' AND le.client_ip IS NULL AND le.headers IS NULL AND le.timeout_s IS NULL AND le.service_tier IS DISTINCT FROM 'batch' AND COALESCE(le.request_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$', FALSE) );

changeSet.author: logos
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION logos_stats_request_state( p_result result_status_enum, p_response timestamptz, p_forwarding timestamptz, p_provider_call timestamptz) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE RETURN CASE WHEN p_result IN ('error', 'timeout') THEN 'error' WHEN p_response IS NOT NULL OR p_result = 'success' THEN 'finished' WHEN p_forwarding IS NOT NULL OR p_provider_call IS NOT NULL THEN 'running' ELSE 'queued' END;
